result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast problem: its headline and promo code text are nearly invisible against the pale mint background. No other clear visual defects were found; the partially visible carousel items and bottom card are expected scroll behavior.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is rendered in white/very light text on a pale mint-green background, making it almost unreadable. The promo code and minimum order condition are effectively lost to users.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., the dark green/near-black used elsewhere) on the light banner, or darken the banner background to a saturated green so white text meets WCAG contrast of at least 4.5:1.
